info.name: Mirror Node REST accounts contracts API

items.docs: Returns a result from EVM execution such as cost-free execution of read-only smart contract queries, gas estimation, and transient simulation of read-write operations. If the `estimate` field is set to true gas estimation is executed. This API can process calls against the `latest` block or specific historical blocks when a hexadecimal or decimal block number is provided in the `block` field.

info.name: Get the opcode traces for a historical transaction on the network with the given transaction ID or hash

params.name: transactionIdOrHash
params.description: Transaction Id or a 32 byte hash with optional 0x prefix

params.name: stack
params.description: If provided and set to false, stack information will not be included in the response

params.name: memory
params.description: If provided and set to true, memory information will be included in the response

params.name: storage
params.description: If provided and set to true, storage information will be included in the response

items.docs:
Re-executes a transaction and returns a result containing detailed information for the execution,
including all values from the {@code stack}, {@code memory} and {@code storage}
and the entire trace of opcodes that were executed during the replay.

Note that to provide the output, the transaction needs to be re-executed on the EVM,
which may take a significant amount of time to complete if stack and memory information is requested.

items.docs:
Search the logs of a specific contract across multiple contract calls. Chained logs are not
included but can be found by calling `/api/v1/contracts/{contractId}/results/{timestamp}`
or `/api/v1/contracts/results/{transactionId}`. When searching by topic a timestamp parameter must be supplied
and span a time range of at most seven days.

## Ordering
The order is governed by the combination of timestamp and index values. If the index param is omitted, the order is determined by the timestamp only.
